marta: Quick standup — need final battlecard copy for Thurs webinar + launch posts. Focus: cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors. Deliverables: 3 claims + 1-line proof, 2 inbound hooks for SDRs, one webinar slide. Can we finish today?

shannon: Keep it claim/evidence/impact. Example: 'Predictable inference economics' / 'reserved pools + batching typically cut token cost 20-40%' / 'reduces cost per conversation.'

ana: Draft claims:
1) 'Predictable performance across hosted, dedicated, private' — proof: 'SLA-backed dedicated pools + smart routing with fallbacks.'
2) 'Lower cost per conversation for chat' — proof: 'continuous batching + KV prefix caching; Optimize suggestions.'
3) 'Enterprise controls without heavy infra lift' — proof: 'Private control plane, KMS/HSM, audit logs, on-prem option.'

priya: SDR hooks (short):"Cloud AI leads: 'Want predictable latency & unit economics? 1-page economics comp.'"
"LLM API leads: 'Need rollouts and private deployments? 30m demo.'"

devops-bot: Landing page deploy 2026-04-02T16:00Z; CI smoke tests 03:30 UTC.

marta: Ana please post one-pager draft by EOD; Marketing will draft social hooks; Priya map routing. Review at 4pm PT.
